what_this_is: How the 8x DP8 endpoint at 1M context behaves under REAL multimodal production load driven through omp by the owner - not a benchmark. Text-agent load (a TB2.1 arm at C16) was running concurrently throughout, so this is a mixed-traffic measurement, which is the realistic case.

workload.driver: omp on the driver VM, tmux session qwen38, model vllm-gg/qwen38
workload.evidence_of_video: 48 video_processing_qwen events in the server log
workload.concurrent_background: TB2.1 1M arm, 8 shards x n=2 = C16

gpu_behaviour.verdict: all eight GPUs effectively saturated, and well balanced
gpu_behaviour.contrast_with_the_needle_ladder: during 12:50-13:20 the same host read 63.6-78.2 % mean utilisation with 20-35 % idle samples and a cross-GPU spread up to 72 points. That was NOT a DP imbalance defect - the needle ladder issues ONE enormous request at a time, so seven of eight replicas are idle by construction. Under concurrent mixed load the spread collapses to 14.7 points. Workload shape, not topology, explained it, and I nearly published the opposite conclusion from a single-instant nvidia-smi sample.

queueing.verdict: zero queueing and zero capacity stalls on all eight engines while saturated

throughput.why_prefill_dominates: images and video expand into very large token counts, so multimodal traffic is prefill-bound in a way text-agent traffic is not

input_output_ratio.consequence: multimodal load is 29.8:1 input:output, three times the 9.94:1 measured on the text-only TB2.1 campaign. Cost for multimodal traffic is therefore almost entirely INPUT-side, so any price sheet that leads with output tokens will misprice it badly.

prefix_caching.significance: FIRST MEASURED evidence for the shared-prefix benefit this project had only ever asserted. omp subagents share system prompts and tool schemas, and the hit rate nearly doubled under that traffic.
prefix_caching.UNIT_CAVEAT: vllm prefix_cache_queries counts BLOCK lookups, not tokens. 48.0 % is a block-level hit rate and is NOT the fraction of prompt tokens skipped. Do not convert it to a token discount without a token-level measurement.

mtp.note: the shipped depth schedule [[1,4,3],[5,64,1]] holds up under multimodal load; acceptance rose slightly

honest_limits: Mixed traffic by construction - a TB2.1 arm ran throughout, so these are not clean multimodal-only numbers.
The owner drove the load interactively, so its composition is not reproducible from a script.
Counter deltas come from one of eight pollers (shard 0 URL) against a DP8 endpoint whose /metrics aggregates across engines; rates are host-wide, not per-shard.
No image/video token accounting: the engine does not expose modality-split prompt tokens, so the 29.8:1 ratio bundles text and vision tokens.

receipts.server_log_evidence: 48 video_processing_qwen lines in ~/logs/serve-dp8-1m.log on the 8x host
